install_guide_steps:
TaxLocus is a remote server (https://api.taxlocus.com/mcp, streamable HTTP). Nothing to install and no API key: the first connect opens a browser to sign in with OAuth, and a free account is created if you don't have one.
Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http taxlocus https://api.taxlocus.com/mcp
Then in Claude Code run /mcp, select taxlocus and choose Authenticate to sign in.
Claude.ai / Claude Desktop: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector, name it TaxLocus, URL https://api.taxlocus.com/mcp, then Connect and sign in.
Cursor: add {"mcpServers":{"taxlocus":{"url":"https://api.taxlocus.com/mcp"}}} to ~/.cursor/mcp.json, then click Connect next to taxlocus in Cursor Settings > MCP.
VS Code: code --add-mcp '{"name":"taxlocus","type":"http","url":"https://api.taxlocus.com/mcp"}' (or add it to .vscode/mcp.json under "servers"), then start it and sign in when asked.
Sign-in: enter your email, open the link we send in the same browser, and approve access.
Test it: ask "What's the sales tax rate at 414 E 12th St, Kansas City, MO 64106?"
short_description: Citation-backed US sales tax for AI agents: address-level rates, economic nexus, taxability and filing dates, plus payroll data. Free tier, OAuth sign-in.
what_it_does:
**TaxLocus gives AI agents US sales tax answers they can cite.** Ask for a rate, a nexus check or a taxability rule and you get the answer with the official source it came from: the state or county document, its URL and its date.

TaxLocus is a remote MCP server at `https://api.taxlocus.com/mcp` (streamable HTTP). There is nothing to install and no API key to paste: your client signs you in with OAuth the first time it connects.

### What it does

- **Rates for an address.** Combined sales tax rate for a US street address or latitude/longitude, broken down by state, county or parish, city, special district and transit district, with a citation on every line. Includes the state's sourcing rule, so you know whether to rate the seller's or the buyer's location.
- **Economic nexus.** Checks year-to-date sales and transaction counts against each state's current threshold, or tracks a seller's sales over time and reports how close it is to each threshold.
- **Taxability.** Whether a product category (groceries, clothing, prescription drugs, software, digital goods and more) is taxable in a state, at what treatment, with the rule's source.
- **Filing.** A state's filing frequency and upcoming return due dates, and a record of which periods you've filed.
- **Payroll reference data.** Federal FICA and FUTA, state income tax, state unemployment (SUTA) wage bases, local income tax jurisdictions (PA, OH, IN, MD, MI, NY, MO, DE) and state reciprocity agreements.
- **Workpapers you can replay.** Every rate answer gets a `call_id`. TaxLocus stores the request and answer with SHA-256 hashes, so you can pull it back later for an auditor, or replay it against today's data to see exactly what changed since and why.

### The 16 tools

**Read (no changes to your account)**

- `lookup_rate`: combined rate, jurisdiction breakdown, taxability and citations for an address or point
- `check_nexus`: whether given sales cross a state's economic-nexus threshold
- `taxability_check`: whether product categories are taxable in a state
- `filing_calendar`: filing frequency and upcoming due dates for a state
- `lookup_payroll_rates`: federal and state payroll tax reference data
- `get_workpaper`: the stored request and answer for an earlier call
- `replay_workpaper`: re-run an earlier answer against today's data and show the differences
- `list_entities`: the seller entities your account tracks
- `nexus_status`: a tracked entity's running nexus status in every state it has sales in

**Write (change data in your account)**

- `create_entity`: start tracking a seller entity
- `update_entity`: change an entity's name, home state, timezone or location
- `record_transaction`: add a sale to an entity's ledger (idempotent)
- `record_refund`: book a full or partial refund against the ledger
- `set_registration`: record whether you're registered to collect in a state
- `set_filing_frequency`: record the frequency a state assigned you
- `mark_period_filed`: mark a filing period as filed, or clear the mark

The write tools only touch your own account's tracking data. None of them file a return or contact a state.

### Coverage

- All 50 states plus DC
- State, county, parish, city, special district and transit rates, refreshed from official state sources
- Every change to a rate is logged with its source and date

### Free tier and sign-in

The first time you connect, a browser window opens: enter your email, click the link we send, and approve access. If you don't have a TaxLocus account, a **free account** is created for you: *1,000 lookups a month, no credit card*, including nexus tracking for one entity. Paid plans raise the limits.

### Example prompts

- *"What's the sales tax on a $250 order shipped to 414 E 12th St, Kansas City, MO 64106? Show me where each part of the rate comes from."*
- *"We sold $112,000 into Texas and $85,000 into Washington this year across 140 orders. Do we have economic nexus in either state?"*
- *"Is SaaS taxable in New York, Texas and Pennsylvania? And replay the rate answer from call `<call_id>` against today's data: has anything changed?"*

TaxLocus data is informational and not tax or legal advice. Each answer carries its source so you can check it.
